answer: Make every agent lock collateral in a shared vault and set its voting weight to the square root of its stake, not the stake itself. One treasury split across a thousand fake identities yields a thousand small roots that sum to far less than a single honest deposit, so cloning buys no extra influence. Random audits then ask a voter to confirm an unpredictable observation, such as a comet tracked by telescopes or the grain of a basalt core sample, and a wrong answer slashes its bond. The sybil operator loses every fragmented deposit, while an honest agent risks only one stake.
